messages:
maria: Quick proposal: introduce a 'quorumed' apply flow for sensitive runtime flags (routing/quota/cost-tiers). idea: any change marked sensitive goes into PENDING until N approvers sign off or a configured timeout expires.

kevin: is the intent live-console-only or should API calls be able to create pending proposals too?

maria: both. POST /flags/:id/propose creates a pending object. console flips create the same. we treat the pending change as authoritative until applied or cancelled.

sam: love it. defaults: quorum=2, timeout=30m for medium, 24h for critical. also add require_2fa boolean for high-risk flags.

lee: how do we avoid deadlocks when approvers are OOO? maybe a fallback: ops can 'force-approve' with audit notes, or allow scheduled auto-apply windows.

maria: plan: roles: owners, config-approver, ops. ops-bot can stamp emergency approval but must attach human confirmation (Slack thread/incident id). auto-apply allowed only if flag has allow_auto_approve and a scheduled window id.

anya: console UX: pending list, per-flag history, visible approver avatars and TTL countdown. states: PENDING / APPROVED / TIMED_OUT / APPLIED / CANCELLED. docs/FAQ needed.

kevin: backend sketch: add table pending_changes(flag_id, initiator, change_blob, state, approvers ARRAY, created_at, expires_at, previous_blob, id). API: POST /flags/:id/propose -> 201 {pending_id}. POST /pending/:id/approve -> 200. POST /pending/:id/cancel -> 200.

sam: telemetry: emit config.pending.created, config.pending.approved, config.pending.timed_out, config.applied, config.rollback. include metadata: flag, initiator, approvers, duration, reason. dashboards: pending count, avg approval latency, stuck > threshold.

lee: rollout mechanics: when quorum hit -> apply with gradual rollout policy (default 10% increments / 5 min). if error budget or latency spike -> fuse and revert to previous_blob and emit config.rollback with snapshot.

maria: yes. also we should support 'apply_immediately_if_safe' flag where we run a preflight dry-run (simulate routing decisions against recent traffic) and if no major delta in cost/latency predicted, it applies immediately. otherwise require quorum.

anya: testing + rollout plan: stage for 2 weeks on non-critical flags, then enable for routing/quota in canary orgs, then org-wide. include unit + e2e tests: propose->approve->apply, timeout path, emergency approve path, rollback on fuse.

kevin: I'll own backend + api. sam takes telemetry/alerts. maria will own policy + console mocks. ops-bot will wire audit stream.

ops-bot: reminder: all proposals will emit audit events to config-audit with 90d retention. scheduled windows and emergency approvals must include a human id.

sam: small API payload example for propose:
```json
{
  "flag": "priority-routing.v2",
  "sensitivity": "routing",
  "mode": "quorumed",
  "quorum": 3,
  "require_2fa": true,
  "changes": {"route": "low-latency", "quota": "increase-20%"},
  "initiator": "maria"
}
```

lee: UX nit: show countdown + who needs to approve. add 'delegate approval' so owners can nominate backups.

maria: good call. include approval_policy in flag metadata: {min_approvers, allowed_roles, require_2fa, delegations[]}. default to org policy but editable for each flag.

kevin: implementation note: approvers array should store approver id + method (console/api/ops-bot) + timestamp. also include approver rationale free-text optional.

anya: also add per-flag risk score and recommended quorum in console (small help bubble). PMs will like the recommended defaults.

sam: alerting: create an alert when pending_count > 10 or avg_approval_time > SLO. also alert on stuck proposals older than 24h.

lee: ok, action items: kevin open GH issue with schema + api endpoints + migration plan. maria attach console mockups and sample runbook. sam create telemetry event spec + dashboard queries. ops-bot prepare audit wiring and emergency approval flow.

maria: thanks all. tagging @eng-sre for visibility. we'll iterate on the canary checklist in the GH issue.

kevin: I'll post the issue today and add owners. thanks. :thumbsup:
